content.user_title: Add Email Verification to Caffeine AI Apps
content.value_statement: Users need a reliable way to prove they control an email address. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Caffeine AI email verification patterns.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to use verifiedEmails to store and query verified email addresses.
Shows how to include MixinEmailVerification for verification link callbacks.
Documents sendVerificationEmail parameters and SendResult handling.
Provides a Motoko registration example that sends a verification email.
Reminds builders to include {{VERIFICATION_URL}} in verification email bodies.
limitations: Focused on Caffeine AI and Motoko modules, not generic SMTP setup.
Depends on the separate extension-email skill for email sending.
Provides limited frontend guidance beyond the required verification URL placeholder.
Example code still requires production validation, escaping, and error handling.

best_practices: Use verifiedEmails as the source of truth for verified email status.
Keep {{VERIFICATION_URL}} in every verification email body.
Escape user-provided text before placing it in HTML email content.
anti_patterns: Do not store verification status separately on the user profile.
Do not remove the verification URL placeholder from email content.
Do not treat a sent email as proof that the address is verified.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps add click-to-verify email ownership checks to Caffeine AI apps.

faq.question: Does it send email by itself?
faq.answer: It uses the email client from the separate extension-email dependency.

faq.question: How is verified status checked?
faq.answer: The skill directs the app to query the verifiedEmails module.

faq.question: What placeholder is required in email content?
faq.answer: The email body must include {{VERIFICATION_URL}} so the verification link can be inserted.

faq.question: Can it support custom email copy?
faq.answer: Yes. Custom copy is supported when it keeps the verification URL placeholder.

faq.question: What should be reviewed before production use?
faq.answer: Review input validation, HTML escaping, duplicate email handling, and error handling for failed sends.
